svg.title: Contingent attribute / מה שבמקריו
svg.desc: Chapter 8, Hebrew p149, English p150. A feature may be absent or different while the subject remains what it is. Two identical complete squares depict the same subject in alternative conditions. One carries the established property diamond; the other is bare. A small two-way elbow connects the alternatives. It depicts possible variation, not a necessary change over time, a logical deduction, a broken essential part, or two different kinds of subject. The diamond is a feature, not a removable physical component. This is an independent Chapter 8 aspect, not an asserted child of Chapter 11 Attribute.
